records.text: “I struck you with burning and jaundice. You multiplied your gardens; the caterpillar devoured your vineyards, fig orchards and olive groves, yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
on how things were with you: when you put twenty sata of barley into a bin, there were ten sata of barley; when you went to the wine vat to draw fifty metretai, there were twenty.
I struck you with barrenness, damage from wind and hail—all the works of your hands—and you did not turn to Me, says the Lord.

triples.relationship: crop loss followed by failure to turn to the Lord
triples.rationale: Amos names caterpillar-devoured vineyards, fig orchards and olive groves, followed by the people's failure to turn to the Lord. Haggai similarly recalls deficient grain and wine yields and struck work, ending with the same failure to turn to Him. Their listed forms of damage remain different.
